reason: A DeepSeek Harness browser UI plugin that adds a persistent whale overlay, session statistics panel, and local Snake mini-game, with no model requests or external service behavior described.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可拖拽的鲸鱼悬浮组件、会话统计面板和本地贪吃蛇小游戏。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable whale overlay, session statistics panel, and local Snake mini-game to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: renders a root-scoped browser overlay with an animated whale
reads selected-session lifecycle and usage statistics projections
displays chat, provider, model, and API statistics in a panel
persists dragged position and personal best in browser-local storage
